laiDetails.initiationProtocol: Loading dose: 150 mg deltoid on day 1, then 100 mg deltoid on day 8. Maintenance from day 38: 75-150 mg gluteal monthly. No oral overlap required if loading protocol followed.

halfLife.notes: Effective half-life ~25-49 days depending on injection site (deltoid faster, gluteal slower). PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.notes: Paliperidone IS itself the 9-OH-risperidone metabolite — no further active metabolites of clinical relevance.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Minimal CYP metabolism — primary clearance is renal. Notably stable across CYP-mediated DDIs, an advantage over risperidone. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Very long tail provides smooth taper after last injection. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Pre-filled syringe. Loading doses (150 mg day 1, 100 mg day 8) MUST be deltoid — gluteal loading is suboptimal. Maintenance can be deltoid or gluteal. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
